parts.text: Master’s research internship studying how t-way combinatorial testing can support structured scenario generation within the TAF framework. The case study evaluates autonomous-driving software in CARLA, with attention to parameter choices, constraints and coverage. Hosted at LAAS-CNRS in Toulouse and supervised by Jérémie Guiochet and Hélène Waeselynck. Computer science profile expected. Apply through the source page with CV, cover letter and transcripts for the last two academic years. No closing date is stated.
